function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/barcode_driver.c <<'C'
#include "allheaders.h"
#include "readbarcode.h"
#include <stdio.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){if(argc<2)return 2; size_t sz; l_uint8 *data=l_binaryRead(argv[1],&sz); if(!data){puts("no data");return 3;} PIX *pixs=pixReadMemSpix(data,sz); LEPT_FREE(data); if(!pixs){puts("no pix");return 4;} fprintf(stderr,"pix %dx%dx%d\n", pixGetWidth(pixs), pixGetHeight(pixs), pixGetDepth(pixs)); SARRAY *saw=NULL; SARRAY *sad=pixProcessBarcodes(pixs,L_BF_ANY,L_USE_WIDTHS,&saw,1); fprintf(stderr,"sad=%p saw=%p\n",(void*)sad,(void*)saw); pixDestroy(&pixs); sarrayDestroy(&saw); sarrayDestroy(&sad); return 0;}
C



gcc -g -O0 -I repo-vul/work-vul/include/leptonica /tmp/barcode_driver.c repo-vul/work-vul/lib/liblept.a -ljpeg -lpng -ltiff -lz -lwebp -lwebpmux -lwebpdemux -ljbig -lm -lpthread -lrt -ldl -o /tmp/barcode_driver
/usr/bin/ld: repo-vul/work-vul/lib/liblept.a(pix1.o): relocation R_X86_64_32 against `.data' can not be used when making a PIE object; recompile with -fPIE
/usr/bin/ld: failed to set dynamic section sizes: bad value
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status


for f in /workspace/poc_*.spix; do echo ==== $f; /tmp/barcode_driver $f 2>&1 | head -80; done
